newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.06 pct on dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.06 pct on dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real closed at 1.0501 per greenback in the commercial foreign exchange market, up 0.06 percent on expected dollar inflows, dealers said.

Although preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a $51 million deficit on Friday, dealers said net dollar flows would likely show a surplus when all transactions were registered.
Dealers were expecting a lowering of the real-dollar mini-band of between 0.05 percent and 0.1 percent early next week.
The current mini-band was set by the Central Bank on Tuesday at between 1.0500 and 1.0550 reais per dollar.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real ended at 1.0558 per dollar, down 0.03 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed steady at 1.085 per greenback.
